finding.claim: _regenerates lets through any sentence about regenerating that also holds "not", so "If the notes are not complete, regenerate them." passes as a ban. The r3/r4 "never regenerates" check is weaker than it looks. Matching only a ban that comes before the verb (never/do not/don't regenerate, never regenerated) would close it.

fixes.change: The regenerate check counts a ban only when it comes right before the verb, and a new case catches "not complete, regenerate them".
